definitions.gloss: again and again; over and over; repeatedly
definitions.explanation: Many times over, usually of a request, warning, or refusal that was repeated without effect.

examples.japanese: {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I warned them again and again.

examples.japanese: {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{応|おう}じない→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧。
examples.english: They don't respond even to repeated requests.

examples.japanese: {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれなかった→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: I asked again and again, but in the end nobody helped me.

notes:
An emphatic form of ⟦{再三|さいさん}→再三：04157_saisan⟧ (repeatedly), literally 'twice or three times, three or four times'. It usually carries frustration: the speaker asked or warned, and nothing happened.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to warn again and again
- {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧: repeated requests
- {再三再四|さいさんさいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって: on repeated occasions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再三|さいさん}→再三：04157_saisan⟧: repeatedly (less emphatic)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times (everyday)
